typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		FamilyID as string,
		ListBillGroupNumber as string,
		TransactionDateTime as string,
		Modality as string,
		UpdateUser as string,
		SubscriberID as string,
		LastName as string,
		FirstName as string,
		BLDFEffDate as string,
		GroupID as string,
		RelationshipCode as string,
		DateOfBirth as string,
		InsertUpdateDelete as string,
		BLDFTermDate as string,
		PayMethod as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT [BatchID]       ,[GroupID]       ,[SubscriberID]       ,[FirstName]       ,[LastName]       ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),CAST([DateOfBirth] AS DATE),101) AS [DateOfBirth]       ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),CAST([TransactionDateTime] AS DATE),101) AS [TransactionDateTime]       ,[UpdateUser]       ,[InsertUpdateDelete]       ,[PayMethod]       ,[Modality]       ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),CAST([BLDFEffDate] AS DATE),101) AS [BLDFEffDate]       ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),CAST([BLDFTermDate] AS DATE),101) AS [BLDFTermDate]       ,RTRIM(LTRIM([FamilyID])) AS [FamilyID]       ,RTRIM(LTRIM([RelationshipCode])) AS [RelationshipCode]       ,RTRIM(LTRIM([ListBillGroupNumber])) AS [ListBillGroupNumber]   FROM [ReverseSync].[MemberList]   WHERE [SubscriberID] NOT IN    ( 	SELECT DISTINCT SubscriberID FROM [ReverseSync].[MemberList] 	WHERE ISNULL(RTRIM(LTRIM([ListBillGroupNumber])),\'\') = \'MULTGROUP\'   )',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> ReadrecordfromMemberListTable
ReadrecordfromMemberListTable sink(input(
		TwoPartyFamily_ID as string,
		ListBillGroupNumber as string,
		TRANSCATION_DTM as string,
		MODALITY as string,
		UPDATE_USER as string,
		SBSB_ID as string,
		SBSB_LAST_NAME as string,
		SBSB_FIRST_NAME as string,
		BLDF_EFF_DT as string,
		GRGR_ID as string,
		RelationshipCode as string,
		DOB as string,
		INSERT_UPDATE_DELETE as string,
		BLDF_TERM_DT as string,
		PAY_METHOD as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		TwoPartyFamily_ID = FamilyID,
		ListBillGroupNumber,
		TRANSCATION_DTM = TransactionDateTime,
		MODALITY = Modality,
		UPDATE_USER = UpdateUser,
		SBSB_ID = SubscriberID,
		SBSB_LAST_NAME = LastName,
		SBSB_FIRST_NAME = FirstName,
		BLDF_EFF_DT = BLDFEffDate,
		GRGR_ID = GroupID,
		RelationshipCode,
		DOB = DateOfBirth,
		INSERT_UPDATE_DELETE = InsertUpdateDelete,
		BLDF_TERM_DT = BLDFTermDate,
		PAY_METHOD = PayMethod)) ~> FlatFileDestination
